overview: The Void Convergence Chamber is the central nexus where void currents and resonance flows merge into a controlled arcane equilibrium.
history: Constructed during early Akhevan expansion to stabilize void‑arcane anomalies.
Luclinite stabilizers added after the first resonance cascade.
Void conduits expanded to support Praesertum ritual alignment.
Custodian orders established to maintain chamber integrity.
Modern chamber remains the most dangerous and sacred arcane site in Ka Vethan.
hooks: A convergence node destabilizes, threatening citywide resonance.
A void conduit emits catastrophic arcane signatures.
Custodians request assistance with a corrupted convergence echo.
A Praesertum ritual requires direct chamber alignment.
